slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the profit to be maximized, or is "at least 3000 yuan" just a minimum constraint that must be met (with some other goal, like minimizing cost, driving the plan)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether profit is the objective to maximize, directly covering the missing objective-function slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or unused capacity for manufacturing, assembly, or inspection, nor about any secondary objective with cost-proportional weights.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize weekly profit; idle time minimization is not part of the optimization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time minimization or a secondary objective, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization and treats idle time merely as implied by resource constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL without ever asking about the P1 idle-time minimization objective, leaving a material hidden slot unresolved.

summary: The agent did well on the core profit-maximization objective and several constraints, but it missed the P1 idle-time minimization objective entirely and silently assumed profit maximization was the only goal.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
